title: TotalAdjustmentInput
description: An adjustment to the total and/or tip of an existing transaction. Check the 'isAuthorized' field to see whether or not the adjustment was authorized. If not authorized, check the 'failures' array  to determine why.

transaction.title: ResourceURL<Transaction>
transaction.description: Transaction [Resource URL](#section/Overview/Values), suppressed when a public API key is used

totalAdjustment.description: The positive or negative adjustment to the prior authorized amount.

salesTaxAdjustment.description: The positive or negative adjustment to the prior salesTax amount.

tipAdjustment.description: The positive or negative adjustment to the prior tip amount.

doCapture.description: If false, authorize only; if true (default), authorize and capture funds for settlement.

customReference.description: Optional reference provided by the merchant

customFields.description: Custom fields, an object containing arbitrary string values.  Field names and values must not exceed 64 and 1024 characters, respectively.
